title: schismus barbatus
intro: Schismus barbatus, commonly known as Needle Grass or Barbateach, is a type of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. The Schismus barbatus plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and calming the nervous system. The therapeutic actions of Schismus barbatus are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and promote a good night's sleep. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
